tools.name: mercury_get_organization
tools.description: Get the organization that the token belongs to: legal business name, DBAs and EIN. Mercury API: GET /organization.

tools.name: mercury_list_accounts
tools.description: List the bank accounts of the organization with balances (current and available), type, status and nickname. Start here to get account ids. Mercury API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: mercury_list_account_statements
tools.description: List monthly statements for one depository account, with period dates and balances. Mercury API: GET /account/{accountId}/statements.

tools.name: mercury_list_treasury_accounts
tools.description: List the Mercury Treasury accounts of the organization. Mercury API: GET /treasury.

tools.name: mercury_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions across all accounts, filterable by date range, account and text search. Use mercury_list_account_transactions for one account and a status filter. Mercury API: GET /transactions.

tools.name: mercury_list_account_transactions
tools.description: List the transactions of one account, filterable by date range, status, text search, category and offset paging. Mercury API: GET /account/{accountId}/transactions.

tools.name: mercury_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction of an account by id: amount, counterparty, status, dates, note and category. Mercury API: GET /account/{accountId}/transaction/{transactionId}.

tools.name: mercury_list_categories
tools.description: List the custom expense categories of the organization (used to tag transactions). Mercury API: GET /categories.

tools.name: mercury_list_recipients
tools.description: List the payment recipients (saved payees) of the organization. Bank details are masked by Mercury. Mercury API: GET /recipients.

tools.name: mercury_get_recipient
tools.description: Get one recipient by id. Mercury API: GET /recipient/{recipientId}.

tools.name: mercury_list_send_money_requests
tools.description: List payment requests waiting for, or finished with, admin approval. Filter by account and status. Mercury API: GET /request-send-money.

tools.name: mercury_get_send_money_request
tools.description: Get one send-money approval request by id: amount, recipient, approvals required and status. Mercury API: GET /request-send-money/{requestId}.

tools.name: mercury_list_transfer_requests
tools.description: List internal transfer approval requests between two accounts of the organization, with status. Mercury API: GET /request-transfer.

tools.name: mercury_request_send_money
tools.description: Create a payment REQUEST from an account to a saved recipient. Mercury does not send the money now: the request waits for admin approval under the organization's approval policy. Only ACH, check and real-time payment are supported. Needs a Custom token with the RequestSendMoney scope. Reuse the same

tools.name: mercury_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers saved for invoicing (accounts receivable). Mercury API: GET /ar/customers.

tools.name: mercury_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices the organization issued (accounts receivable): status, amounts, due dates and customers. Mercury API: GET /ar/invoices.

tools.name: mercury_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one issued invoice by id, with line items, payments and status. Mercury API: GET /ar/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: mercury_list_reimbursements
tools.description: List expense reimbursements of the organization, oldest first by default, with review and payment status. Mercury API: GET /spend/reimbursements.

tools.name: mercury_get_reimbursement
tools.description: Get one reimbursement by id: submitter, amount, review and payment status, and comments. Mercury API: GET /spend/reimbursements/{reimbursementId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mercury_request_send_money, mercury_list_reimbursements, mercury_get_reimbursement · Private data: mercury_get_organization, mercury_request_send_money · Public sink: mercury_list_send_money_requests, mercury_get_send_money_request, mercury_request_send_money.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mercury_request_send_money, mercury_list_reimbursements, mercury_get_reimbursement · Private data: mercury_get_organization, mercury_request_send_money · Public sink: mercury_list_send_money_requests, mercury_get_send_money_request, mercury_request_send_money

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
